unsupported: Messenger Molding & Manufacturing was founded in 1976 by Ron Messenger in California.
Now in its second generation of family ownership, the business has spent nearly five decades building precision molds and running plastic injection molding programs for customers worldwide.
Secondary operations cover sonic welding, pad printing, assembly, drilling, tapping, and automation integration.
While the company does not publicize specific industry verticals, its capabilities in clean-room molding and precision tooling suggest alignment with medical, electronics, and industrial sectors.
A commitment to on-time delivery and just-in-time shipping arrangements for select customers rounds out the service model.
